|errata_history={{Card errata/Kef Bir: Oceanic Wreckage}}
This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Kef Bir: Oceanic Wreckage]] (version 2 of 2). The image here is the current Players Committee card image published 30 December 2024. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image that differs visibly from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Kef Bir: Oceanic Wreckage]]): '''First published 20 December 2021''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/hires/kefbiroceanicwreckage.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f54fd7f7220526489ac0bc6fe4a71a89ca75069 commit 6f54fd7]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Virtual Set 17 release; card image first published 21 December 2021<ref name="img-2021-12-21-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Light/large/kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif</code> as published 21 December 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif holotable commit 8190af8] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: Unless you occupy, Kylo and Sidious deploy -1 here. Light: Unless Ben Solo, Han, or Rey here, Force drain -1 here.” This image was first published on 20 December 2021 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/hires/kefbiroceanicwreckage.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f54fd7f7220526489ac0bc6fe4a71a89ca75069 commit 6f54fd7]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E1) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): '''First published 29 December 2024''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/hires/kefbiroceanicwreckage.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba commit efc26cd]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Card image published 30 December 2024, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set17Type.html Virtual Set 17 card list]<ref name="img-2024-12-30-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Light/large/kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/kefbiroceanicwreckage.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Light: While Rey alone here, she is immune to attrition. Dark: While Rey alone here, you may not Force drain at Kylo's location.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Light Side text “Unless Ben Solo, Han, or Rey here, Force drain -1 here.” became “While Rey alone here, she is immune to attrition.”. Dark Side text “Unless you occupy, Kylo and Sidious deploy -1 here.” became “While Rey alone here, you may not Force drain at Kylo's location.”.
